detail: Expected detail is 'the ship validator's message', which is not concrete. Name the exact message from the ship command validator, or assert only status 400 and a non-empty validation detail.

Mutating cases (TC-11 cancels order 7, TC-12 ships order 6, TC-13 cancels order 7) share seeded orders with cases that require the original state (TC-02 Paid order 6, TC-03 Submitted order 7, TC-10 Paid order 6). The plan does not say whether each case reloads fresh data or uses dedicated orders, so results depend on run order. State per-case isolation or give mutating cases their own orders.

'No second cancellation event' is not observable through any listed public interface. Replace it with an observable check such as final order status or the event count read through a published interface, or drop it.

Retry with the same x-requestid after a rejected or not-found request is covered only for cancel (TC-14, TC-15); the ship endpoint has the same opt-in handler but no functional retry case (only the TC-17 unit guard). Optionally add a ship retry case after a rejected ship (e.g. order 7 Submitted, 409 twice).
location: Implementation Notes: retry after a failed cancel/ship
